escalations.title: Handlebars.js Multiple Critical Code Injection Vulnerabilities
escalations.summary: JavaScript injection via AST manipulation and prototype pollution in Handlebars templating engine

escalations.title: Tinypool Prototype Pollution → Remote Code Execution
escalations.summary: RCE via prototype pollution in Tinypool worker pool (transitive from vitest)
escalations.fix: Update vitest across all projects to latest

escalations.title: proxy-addr IPv4-mapped IPv6 Spoofing → Authentication Bypass
escalations.summary: IP-based access control bypass via crafted IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses in Express proxy-addr
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update express; cd Portal/Backend && npm update express

escalations.title: protobufjs Multiple Critical Code Injection & DoS Vulnerabilities
escalations.summary: RCE and prototype pollution via malformed .proto schema files in protobufjs
escalations.fix: cd Portal/Backend && npm update protobufjs; cd Orchestrator && npm update protobufjs

escalations.title: OpenTelemetry Database Username Exposure in Traces
escalations.summary: Database usernames leaked unconditionally as db.user span attributes in distributed tracing
escalations.fix: cd Portal/Backend && npm update @opentelemetry/instrumentation-*; configure span attribute masking

backlog.title: GET /api/search route not implemented; 5 tests explicitly written to fail
backlog.summary: Search route specified in FR-dependency-search is missing from app.ts; test file documents this gap explicitly at line 5
backlog.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts implementing GET /api/search?q= and register in app.ts

backlog.title: dev-workflow-platform.md FR-001–FR-032 entirely unimplemented in Source/
backlog.summary: 34 functional requirements in the platform spec have zero implementation; codebase implements a different system (self-judging workflow) with incompatible entity model
backlog.recommendation: Convene with requirements-reviewer: either archive stale spec or create full re-implementation plan

backlog.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read
backlog.summary: Vitest UI dev server allows arbitrary file read and execution when listening; CI/CD pipelines may be exposed
backlog.recommendation: npm update vitest@latest across all projects

backlog.title: tiered-merge-pipeline.md FR-TMP-001–010 have zero implementation
backlog.summary: 10 FRs for risk classification, E2E generation, Playwright runner, auto-PR, AI PR review, auto-merge are fully unimplemented
backlog.recommendation: Create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md mirroring FR-TMP-* IDs or formally defer in spec

backlog.title: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram missing from metrics.ts
backlog.summary: FR-dependency-metrics requires 4 Prometheus metrics; dependencyCheckDuration histogram (4th) is not defined or exported
backlog.recommendation: Add Histogram for dependency_check_duration_seconds in metrics.ts; instrument isReady() and computeHasUnresolvedBlockers()

backlog.title: FR-dependency-seed — Seed data not implemented
backlog.summary: Spec requires idempotent seed data for 7 items with dependency relationships; no seed file exists, in-memory store starts empty
backlog.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/seed.ts with idempotent seeding; call from app.ts startup when NODE_ENV !== 'test'

backlog.title: Route handlers call store directly — no service layer
backlog.summary: CLAUDE.md mandates no direct DB calls from route handlers; both route files import and call store functions directly
backlog.recommendation: Create workItemService.ts wrapping store operations; route handlers should only marshal input/output

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer only scans most-recent plan — false PASS reported
backlog.summary: Mandatory verification gate auto-selects the most recently modified requirements.md, silently skipping 34 unimplemented FRs in older plans
backlog.recommendation: Update enforcer to scan all requirements.md files in Plans/ or emit warnings for skipped plans

backlog.title: PostCSS Path Traversal & XSS Vulnerabilities
backlog.summary: PostCSS path traversal via sourceMappingURL in CSS comments; XSS via unescaped </style> in CSS stringify output

backlog.title: Vite Path Traversal & Windows Privilege Escalation
backlog.summary: Vite dev server path traversal, NTLMv2 hash disclosure, server.fs.allow bypass, and arbitrary command execution via editor options
backlog.recommendation: npm update vite@latest in Source/Frontend and Portal/Frontend

backlog.title: Two logger implementations with incompatible call signatures
backlog.summary: Dual logger implementations produce inconsistent JSON log structure in production (message vs msg field naming)
backlog.recommendation: Standardize on one logger signature; migrate all callers to object-style { msg, ...fields }

backlog.title: ESLint suppressions hiding React Hook dependency bugs
backlog.summary: Two eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in production code may mask stale closure bugs
backlog.recommendation: Audit both suppression sites; fix dependency array or add explanatory comment if intentional

backlog.title: Brace-Expansion Denial of Service (8 CVEs)
backlog.summary: Crafted brace expansion patterns cause CPU exhaustion, memory exhaustion, or stack overflow

backlog.title: Browserslist Unbounded Memory Growth & Prototype Pollution
backlog.summary: No cache eviction in browserslist leads to eventual OOM; tampered browserslist-stats.json enables prototype write
backlog.recommendation: npm update browserslist@^4.28.7 across all projects

backlog.title: form-data CRLF Injection
backlog.summary: form-data fails to escape multipart field names and filenames, allowing HTTP header injection
backlog.recommendation: npm update form-data@^4.0.6 across all projects

backlog.title: joi Prototype Pollution & Regex DoS
backlog.summary: joi allows prototype pollution via __proto__ in custom messages; quadratic regex backtracking in isoDate() and email()

backlog.title: js-yaml Denial of Service via Merge Key Chains
backlog.summary: Crafted YAML with merge key chains causes quadratic CPU consumption and !!omap resolution hang

backlog.title: react-router-dom Open Redirect & XSS
backlog.summary: Same-origin redirect bypass via // prefix, arbitrary constructor injection in SSR, open redirect via backslash

summary.grade_reason: Exploitable auth bypass (DEP-004: proxy-addr IP spoofing) and critical domain failure (DEP-003 RCE, DEP-005 RCE, DEP-001 code injection) trigger the F threshold per inspector.config.yml grading rules
